counties.district: Prosecutorial District 10; Superior Court District 10; District Court District 10
counties.notes: Seat and town list are general knowledge, not read from an official page today. Second courthouse: Wake County Courthouse, 316 Fayetteville St. Mall, Raleigh 27601, same main phone. Wake.gov pages disagree on the Hammond Rd ZIP: 27610 on the facility's own location page (used here), 27602 on the detention division page, 27603 on a forensic-services page. Public Safety Center ZIP is 27601 on its location page, 27602 on the detention page. 919-856-5952 is shown for the Public Safety Center on the detention page beside PREA contact text; confirm it is a general line before publishing. The lookup URL is the Bureau of Forensic Services arrest records portal (last 30 days of arrests, no photos), not a live in-custody roster; no official who-is-in-jail tool was found. The magistrate location came from a search summary of the wake.gov page; my direct read of that page did not surface the sentence.
